item.title: 一站式产品矩阵
item.summary: 一站式矩阵可以把 AI 入口带到模型、数据库、存储、计算、身份和运维，但公开证据只证明相关性与共同部署，不足以证明增量交叉销售或正贡献。Google 当前披露了最直接的 1.8x 产品使用指标，AWS 的生产架构链最可观察，Microsoft 有三工作负载采用信号，Alibaba 的数据联动正在成形；尚无玩家公开同 cohort 的 attach、续约与完全成本贡献。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 竞争将从产品目录数量转向一个账户下的默认工作流、共享身份/数据/治理、可预算计费和可逆迁移。若玩家能披露同 cohort 从 AI 入口到多服务留存、续约和贡献，矩阵可能从 pilot 走向 scale；否则只是更复杂的捆绑。
synthesis.strategic_summary: 一站式矩阵可以把 AI 入口带到模型、数据库、存储、计算、身份和运维，但公开证据只证明相关性与共同部署，不足以证明增量交叉销售或正贡献。Google 当前披露了最直接的 1.8x 产品使用指标，AWS 的生产架构链最可观察，Microsoft 有三工作负载采用信号，Alibaba 的数据联动正在成形；尚无玩家公开同 cohort 的 attach、续约与完全成本贡献。
synthesis.why_now: AI 正成为云消费的新入口，同时成本归因、跨云选择、互操作与共享控制面故障被监管、FinOps 调查和事故证据同时推到经营前台。
winner_conditions: 同 cohort 的 production attach rate、90/365天 retained service count 和首次续约可复核
跨服务完全成本、净收入和贡献按工作负载可归因
共享身份、数据和治理降低时间成本而不制造不可逆锁定
跨区/跨云降级与迁移经过生产验证

evidence.source_quote: more than 50% of Fabric customers – like Amore Pacific, Louisiana state government, and Petrobras – use three or more workloads
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Discloses multi-workload adoption inside an integrated data platform, but not same-cohort incremental revenue or causality.

evidence.source_quote: AI spending is now managed by the majority of respondents (63% up from 31% last year)
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent survey counterevidence: portfolio breadth expands cost visibility, allocation and unit-economics burden.

evidence.source_quote: Azure surpassed $75 billion in revenue, up 34 percent, driven by growth across all workloads
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Provides disclosed scale for the portfolio, while leaving entry-product attachment and cohort economics undisclosed.

evidence.source_quote: Amazon Cognito validates the authentication details
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Reference architecture makes the service graph explicit across identity, storage, search, API, compute, front end and model runtime.

evidence.source_quote: build AI features without moving data out of your database
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Shows first-party Model Studio model and embedding calls attached directly to ApsaraDB RDS via SQL.

evidence.source_quote: Using AI summaries, our users save 87 percent of their time
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named production case ties Bedrock to Lambda and SQS, 55,000 monthly summaries and an outcome metric.

evidence.source_quote: The results already indicate an accuracy of over 90 percent
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named customer progression from Bedrock to S3, OpenSearch, SageMaker, API Gateway, Lambda and a second forecasting use case.

evidence.source_quote: These AI customers use 1.8x as many products as those who do not
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Direct vendor-reported product-attachment metric for AI customers, with explicit portfolio and revenue-growth framing.

evidence.source_quote: OpenSearch Serverless starting at just one OCU for development and test workloads for about $175/month
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Provides an explicit attached-service price anchor and integration among Bedrock, S3 and OpenSearch.

evidence.source_quote: import data from OSS to Model Studio
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Shows a governed storage-to-Agent path with bucket authorization and tagging requirements rather than frictionless attachment.

evidence.source_quote: published to third-party platforms such as DingTalk and WeChat Official Accounts
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Defines one agent entry, knowledge base and plugins, external distribution, token billing and explicit preview/region limits.

evidence.source_quote: Amazon and Microsoft have positions of significant market power
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Counterevidence that integrated portfolio leverage can restrict interoperability, switching and multi-cloud choice.

evidence.source_quote: Bringing AI directly to your data using first-party model integration with BigQuery and Vertex AI
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Shows a low-friction data-to-model path through SQL, BigQuery ML, Vertex AI and serverless analytics.

evidence.source_quote: Multiple Google Cloud and Google Workspace products experienced increased 503 errors
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Direct operational counterexample: shared API management can propagate one failure across an integrated portfolio.

evidence.source_quote: The platform already has more than 800 active users
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named SMB production case uses Bedrock, Lambda, RDS, EC2, S3, Auto Scaling and load balancing behind one agent entry.
